name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: A government scheme that provides income support to farmers.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning cultivable land.
steps: Register on PM Kisan official website or through local authorities.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: A platform providing scholarships to students from economically weaker sections.
eligibility: Students with low family income enrolled in recognized institutions.
benefits: Financial support for education including tuition fees.
steps: Apply online through the NSP portal.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A savings scheme for the girl child to support education and marriage expenses.
eligibility: Parents or guardians of a girl child below 10 years.
benefits: High interest savings with tax benefits.
steps: Open account at a bank or post office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: A housing scheme to provide affordable homes to the urban and rural poor.
eligibility: Economically weaker sections and low-income groups.
benefits: Subsidized home loans and financial assistance.

name: Ayushman Bharat Yojana
description: A health insurance scheme providing coverage for medical expenses.
eligibility: Low-income families identified under SECC database.
benefits: Up to ₹5 lakh health coverage per family per year.
steps: Register through hospitals or official portal.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from poor households.
benefits: Free LPG connection and subsidy on cylinders.

name: Stand Up India Scheme
description: Supports entrepreneurship among women and SC/ST communities.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore.

name: e-Shram Portal Scheme
description: A scheme to provide social security benefits to unorganized workers.
eligibility: Workers in unorganized sector like laborers, construction workers, domestic workers.
benefits: Accident insurance and access to welfare schemes.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan
description: Pension scheme for unorganized sector workers.
eligibility: Workers aged 18–40 with monthly income below ₹15000.
steps: Enroll through CSC centers or online.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
description: Scholarship scheme for girl students pursuing technical education.
eligibility: Girl students admitted to AICTE approved institutions.
